Rae (Sales): Heads-up: BetaCorp asked for a one-page SIG follow-up on BCP/DR: RTO/RPO for Dedicated vs Hosted, backup cadence, failover steps, and recent test evidence. Need by COB tomorrow.
Sam (Eng-SRE): Noted. They're targeting Dedicated for prod. I'll give numbers and a tiny runbook excerpt.
Devon (Infra): Quick draft: Dedicated: contractual uptime 99.95% (SLA), node failover <3m, region failover <45m with cross-region replication. RPO: control-plane <10m; default data snapshot daily, hourly optional. Hosted: multi-AZ with regional reroute; observed failover 15-60m depending on warm capacity. RPO default 24h.
Priya (Security): Backups encrypted at rest; Private bring-your-own-KMS supported. Default retention 30 days; extended retention available. We run quarterly sample restores and an annual Dedicated DR exercise. Can share redacted summary.
Sam (Eng-SRE): Runbook snippet to paste: 
```
1) Alert -> verify degraded zone.
2) Promote warm replica, update routing & DNS.
3) Smoke tests & consistency checks.
4) If >5% errors escalate to on-call.
5) Post-incident snapshot & RCA.
```
Rae (Sales): Great. Devon & Priya please drop links to SLA and DR summary and I'll assemble the one-pager.
Devon (Infra): SLA: https://redwood.example.com/legal/sla
Priya (Security): DR summary (redacted): https://redwood.example.com/internal/dr-tests/2025-q2-redacted
